entries.zh: 嘲弄，戏弄；说笑取笑人
entries.en: to mock, to make fun of; to jeer at

entries.zh: 戏弄而使人受损、落得纠乱（L 后半「venir a laberynto」义不明）
entries.en: to mock (someone) so as to leave them harmed and entangled (second half of the Spanish headword uncertain)
entries.notes: L 后半疑为 laberynto 或 la burla，R 末音疑 dun/sun；仅「取笑＋损害」可定

entries.zh: 齿笑；露齿而笑以讥人，嘲笑
entries.en: to sneer at; to laugh at someone showing the teeth
entries.notes: L 之「dtes.」即 dientes（齿），与 H 齒笑 相应

entries.zh: 粗鲁地戏弄；粗俗取笑
entries.en: to mock coarsely; to make crude jokes at someone

entries.zh: 放纵地戏弄；粗野胡闹地取笑
entries.en: to mock wildly; to tease boisterously

entries.zh: 恶意戏弄；狠心嘲弄
entries.en: to mock spitefully; to tease meanly

entries.zh: 粗野辱骂，斥人下贱；恶言轻侮
entries.en: to revile as base; to mock insultingly, calling someone worthless

entries.zh: 跳弄；晃着东西（纸张、契据条款）当面戏弄人
entries.en: to caper mockingly; to taunt someone by flourishing something before them (papers, a contract's terms)
entries.notes: L 之「pliegos」疑作「plumas」，「condiciones」指契据条款，与「跳弄」当面晃示相应

entries.zh: 母驴
entries.en: she-ass, female donkey
entries.notes: L 栏疑 Burra/Buxa，然 H 驢母 与 burra 相合，取「母驴」

entries.zh: 寻找，找
entries.en: to look for, to seek

entries.zh: 寻思，反复思量
entries.en: to ponder, to think over

entries.zh: 寻看；边看边找，察看寻找
entries.en: to look for while scanning about; to search visually
entries.notes: H「省」与 R「cān」、M「cua」不合，二字皆指「看」，疑 H 为「看」之讹；义取「边看边找」

entries.zh: 寻见，找着
entries.en: to seek and find

entries.zh: 寻而不见，找不到
entries.en: to look for and not find

entries.zh: 寻后手；找剩下的、残余之物
entries.en: to look for what is left over; to pick up the remnants

entries.zh: 寻缝；找缝隙，寻可乘之隙
entries.en: to look for a seam or gap; to seek an opening (a way in)
entries.notes: L 栏残缺（疑「roto de la defesa」，防线缺口），H/M/R 三栏一致指「找缝」，因残栏降为中等

entries.zh: 查；查验（为作证、取证而查）
entries.en: to check, to examine (so as to certify or verify)
entries.notes: L「p̃」疑为 para 之缩写，「buscar para certificarse」即「为作证而查」，与 查 相合

entries.zh: 查着；查问而得，查到、查获
entries.en: to find out by inquiry; to trace down and find

entries.zh: 搜；翻找，抄翻东西地找
entries.en: to search by rummaging; to ransack (trasegar)

entries.zh: 搜寻，到处寻找
entries.en: to search for, to seek out
